definitions: A person, especially a young man, who uses excessive amounts of hair gel or pomade to style their hair.
A derogatory term for a mechanic or someone who works with machinery and gets dirty.
A member of a youth subculture in the 1950s and early 1960s, especially in the United States, characterized by slicked-back hair, leather jackets, and a rebellious attitude.
examples: He looked like a classic greaser from a 50s movie.
The old greaser fixed my engine in no time.
The greasers hung out by the diner.
